name: javmeta_crawl_dispatch_critical
description: Due crawl work has not been dispatched within the critical threshold configured in Cài đặt.

query_condition.sql: SELECT _timestamp, severity, value FROM (SELECT _timestamp, severity, value FROM "javmeta_crawl_dispatch_stale" WHERE severity = 'critical' AND _timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL '5 minutes' ORDER BY _timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) AS latest WHERE value > 0
